description: Runs a prompt against up to 5 REAL, directly-verified vendor models — you_com (You.com Answer API), deepseek, grok (xAI), meta_ai (Meta's Model API) and minimax — each called through that vendor's own public API. Unlike explore_ai_prompt's persona labels, every result here reports the real vendor model id in `modelName`. A model whose API key is not configured on this deployment answers `status: "unavailable"` with no call made — a deployment fact, not an error; `status: "error"` means the vendor is configured but the call failed. `webSearch` is best-effort per vendor: You.com is always grounded, grok honours it, and deepseek, meta_ai and minimax always answer `webSearch: false`. meta_ai is a US-developers-only public preview, so an ineligible account reports an error naming that. Billed on the operator's own vendor keys: no plan gate and no MisarSEO credits are spent.

highlightBrand.description: A brand/entity name to highlight mentions of in each answer.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to each requested vendor model.

webSearch.description: Ask for grounded answers where the vendor supports it (see the tool description). Defaults to false.

name: get_direct_vendor_answers
